label: Show Don't Tell
description: Flags passages that tell emotion or judgment instead of showing it.
usage: Rewrite flagged telling passages to show emotion through action and sensory detail.
chapter_instruction: Find telling vs showing in this chapter. Fill only the required markdown headings below (use exactly those heading texts). Use short quotes or location cues. Write "none" under a heading if empty. Do not write the full-book report yet—chapter notes only.
final_instruction: Produce a Show Don't Tell report. Merge the chapter notes below into one author-facing markdown report for this analysis. Group patterns across chapters, cite chapter names, rank severity where useful, and do not invent manuscript details not supported by the notes.
